scope: Public-safe G0-G2 candidate evidence for python-faster-whisper 1.2.1-2, the PyAV 19 fix for speech transcription breaks on PyAV 19 (#124). It replaces the python-faster-whisper part of the speech-providers-4.8.2-1.2.1 record; the CTranslate2 4.8.2-1 evidence there carries over unchanged. It does not promote the sublane. Publication, production installation, and the Open WebUI cutover remain outside this record.

repository_source.source_commit_note: The squash merge of https://github.com/nisavid/arch-pkgs/pull/125 on main; the archive was built from it.

backport.scope: faster_whisper/audio.py only; the hunk is upstream's, byte for byte

checks.verifysource: makepkg --verifysource passed; the tag tarball matched its b2sum
checks.cold_tree: the build used a git archive of tree 042e1f6 at 86549fa; every exported blob matched the commit tree
checks.compatibility_matrix: Faster Whisper 1.2.1 requires ctranslate2>=4.0,<5, huggingface_hub>=0.21, tokenizers>=0.13,<1, onnxruntime>=1.14,<2, av>=11, and tqdm. The patch keeps av unversioned: it passes metadata_errors="ignore" to av.open() only below PyAV 19.
checks.upstream_release_review: PyAV 19.0.0 removed the metadata_encoding and metadata_errors arguments to av.open() and always decodes metadata as UTF-8 with surrogateescape; 19.0.1 has fixes only. faster-whisper has no release after 1.2.1; upstream fixed the call on master in 2ce7f9d (PR #1495), which changes only faster_whisper/audio.py. The other commits on master since v1.2.1 (new Silero VAD weights, new VAD parameters, a huggingface_hub floor) are not taken.

builder.tool: makepkg -f --nodeps --cleanbuild inside a bubblewrap namespace with only loopback, a read-only host, and fresh /tmp, /run, and home; every depends and makedepends entry was already installed (pacman -T), so --nodeps only kept makepkg from calling pacman; nothing was installed

payload_checks.baseline_diff: against the 1.2.1-1 archive (sha256 9b052be8...), only faster_whisper/audio.py, the dist-info RECORD line for audio.py, and the package metadata (.PKGINFO, .BUILDINFO, .MTREE) differ; every other payload file is byte-identical
payload_checks.patch_reapplied: the 1.2.1-1 audio.py re-patched with the committed patch at --fuzz=0 equals the packaged audio.py byte for byte
payload_checks.av_open_gate: the packaged audio.py carries the _AV_OPEN_KWARGS gate and no unconditional metadata_errors call
payload_checks.no_local_paths_in_payload: no build or home path appears in .PKGINFO, .BUILDINFO, .MTREE, or any payload file

fixture.kind: declared Python 3.14 CPU provider fixture, as in the speech-providers-4.8.2-1.2.1 G2: the candidate archives extracted into one overlay root that leads PYTHONPATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH over the host's installed system providers, run inside an unprivileged network namespace that has only loopback. PyAV is the host's, so the run exercises decode_audio() against the installed PyAV 19.
fixture.environment: env -i; HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES, and ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1

derived_from.change: Drops the CTranslate2 bundled-model and malformed-model checks, which the CTranslate2 4.8.2-1 evidence covers; adds the PyAV identity, the av.open() keyword gate, the Silero VAD digest, a direct decode_audio() call, and a baseline-control mode for the unpatched 1.2.1-1 archive. The transcription checks are unchanged.

whisper_model.note: The acceptance kit's default Whisper pin (tools/open_webui_household_scenarios.py WHISPER_BASE), which the household rehearsal and trial speech-to-text smoke use. The 1.2.1-1 record used the tiny model, which this host does not hold.

baseline_control.note: The unpatched 1.2.1-1 archive over the same CTranslate2 overlay and host PyAV. The control passes only when decode_audio() raises the PyAV 19 TypeError, so the fixture is shown to detect the defect that 1.2.1-2 fixes.

ownership.unowned_note: Host files are the loaded files under /usr; pacman -Qo owns every one not listed as unowned. The other mapped paths, shown as placeholders, are an anonymous POSIX semaphore (/dev/shm/<anonymous>), the dynamic linker cache (<other>/ld.so.cache), the cuda package's libOpenCL.so.1.0.0, outside /usr (<other>/libOpenCL.so.1.0.0), and the harness (<scratch>/g2_fixture.py); of these, only the cuda package's libOpenCL.so.1.0.0 is package payload.

carried_over.note: The CTranslate2 G0-G2 results, including the upstream Python tests and the bundled-model and malformed-model checks, are not rerun. Both archives are the same bytes and enter this record's overlay unchanged.

supersedes.note: 1.2.1-1 passed G0-G2 on PyAV 18.1.0. Its decode_audio() raises TypeError on PyAV 19, so it is no longer a candidate.
